Maya Singh: scan flagged a partner CI image with a baked-in ~/.vault-token. Token active window ~36h. Marking P0 and starting containment.
Oliver Grant: which image? any external pulls?
Maya Singh: gcr.io/partner-inc/ingest:20260322. Access logs show internal cluster pulls only, but we must assume exposure.
Priya Nair: immediate checklist: 1) revoke token + partner SA keys, 2) snapshot affected ciphertexts, 3) create read-only evidence bucket, 4) rewrap ciphertexts to transit-v2, 5) rotate implicated secrets (canary then full), 6) tighten RBAC for partner role.
Brenda Li: I'll take revocation + evidence. Creating gs://redwood-sec-evidence/318765 and will upload snapshots + signed manifest.
vault-bot: Audit export queued -> bq://security_audit.vault_leaks.318765
ops-bot: vault token revoke job queued: `vault token revoke <redacted>`
Oliver Grant: token policy allowed secret/* on staging and transit/rewrap. Assume possible reads/rewraps. We'll provision a new KMS keyversion for transit and avoid touching auto-unseal.
Priya Nair: agree. Rewrap sequence: create transit-v2 keyversion, snapshot ciphertexts, canary rewrap two secrets, rotate canary creds, smoke test, then full rewrap+rotate. Proposed window 02:00-02:30 UTC. Ops oncall?
Brenda Li: token revoked at 01:48 UTC. Snapshots uploaded to evidence bucket. Generating SHA256 list and will GPG sign manifest.
Oliver Grant: canary rewrap started 02:00 UTC (two secrets) -> completed 02:04 UTC. No errors.
Priya Nair: canary DB credential rotated 02:10 UTC, smoke ingestion passed on canary pods.
Brenda Li: full rotate + rewrap finished 02:27 UTC. Evidence bundle uploaded: gs://redwood-sec-evidence/318765/manifest.gpg. Audit logs show revoked token and subsequent failed access attempts.
Priya Nair: RBAC change: partner role PR created -> infra/PR-4599 to remove transit write and restrict secret paths.
Maya Singh: post-incident actions: 1) CI lint to fail builds that include dotfiles or ~/.vault-token, 2) require vault-agent/CSI or short-lived tokens for builds, 3) registry scanner to detect tokens in images, 4) default partner policies deny transit write.
Brenda Li: partner notified and asked for remediation plan within 48h. Evidence retained 90d; bucket set to read-only for sec team.
Priya Nair: good work. I'll open the postmortem and assign owners. Closing thread once linked. :white_check_mark:
